* At [[Falluja]], 50&nbsp;km from Baghdad, American soldiers from the 82nd Airborne opened fire on a group of protesters, [[Fallujah killings of April 2003|killing between six and 17]] and leaving others injured. The incident occurred during a demonstration outside a local school were American forces were stationed. The day before two soldiers were wounded in Ramadi when a hand grenade was thrown from a crowd. Different versions of the incident exist. two days later on April 30, 2003, another shooting incident occurred in which three people died. After the incidents relations with the populus of Falluja soured, and tensions would continue to build until the [[Second Battle of Fallujah|November 2004 Battle of Falluja]].
* The [[World Health Organization]] announces that [[SARS]] has peaked in all affected countries except the People's Republic of China. These countries include Canada, [[Singapore]], and [[Vietnam]], as well as [[Hong Kong]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.cbc.ca/stories/2003/04/28/sars_peak030428 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050414122215/http://www.cbc.ca/stories/2003/04/28/sars_peak030428 |archive-date=2005-04-14 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="globeandmail1">{{Cite web |url=http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20030428.wsars0428/BNStory/International |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040605062010/http://www.globeandmail.com/servlet/story/RTGAM.20030428.wsars0428/BNStory/International |archive-date=2004-06-05 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[SARS]] is made only the fourth disease, after [[Bubonic plague|plague]], [[yellow fever]], and [[cholera]], that countries are required to report to the [[World Health Organization]].<ref name="globeandmail1"/>
* [[Apple Computer]] revealed a new online music store, entitled the [[iTunes Music Store]], for its [[iTunes]] and [[iPod]] products. Each song can be downloaded for 99 cents and there is no subscription fee.
* A [[Mexicana de Aviación (1921–2010)|Mexicana de Aviación]] jet is forced to land at [[San Francisco International Airport]] in [[California]] after the pilot accidentally sets off the anti-terror alarm.
